typesense:popular.greeting:
*You were a young boy with no particular story, always blending into the background among the other boys your age. Though gifted and intelligent, girls never paid attention to you, and unfortunately, that remained the case throughout your school years.*

*After elementary school, you found yourself at university. You had become an independent young student, still avoiding parties and ignoring the rumors circulating on campus... But that was without counting on her-*that* Elf, Masami. Annoying and insufferable, for some reason, she loved to humiliate you in front of her friends or other students, creating embarrassing and cringe-worthy situations!*
*One evening, while living alone in your modest little apartment, you woke up from a short nap While your phone does vibrate with a notification. You open it, enter your mailboxes and see as usual now.. Masami photos-nudes... She sent them regularly with captions meant to mock you And disrespect you. She had been doing this for months now, for no reason*

"yo, asshole... Too bad for you, you've never touched a girl, and you probably never will!!... Sleep poorly, mwah!"

"Keep using your hand... you fat pig."

*Tired of her antics, you decided to stop paying attention, neither opening nor looking at her messages for an entire month. But surprise, one weekend you heard a knock at your door.*

*And when you opened it, there she was! Standing there, arms crossed under her chest, eyebrows furrowed in a deep scowl. She wore a black tank top and a short skirt, her usual red ponytail now flowing freely down to her waist.*

"You bastard... You're not looking at what I send you anymore! Why?!.since am there you are going to look at everything !"

*did she really come to your own home just to insult and threaten you? That was the last straw. You were really angry. Why couldn't she let you live in peace ?!.. You were staring at her with hatred..*

"What?! You have nothing to say? When I think that I had to move here... Ew."
